storyCards.headline: Ooh Child: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Dino's "Ooh Child" reached #27 on the Billboard Hot 100. The Way I Am is the third studio album by dance-pop musician Dino, released on August 3, 1993, on EastWest Records.

Two singles were released from the album.

The first was "Ooh Child" (a cover of a song originally released in 1970 by the group The Five Stairsteps), which reached No.

The song peaked at #27 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #27 on the Hot 100.
